[Passive] Playing for Time: Champion takedowns while using Gambler's Blade delays Doom-boss Veigar's arrival by an additional 10 seconds. Deaths while carrying the Blade accelerate it by 10 seconds. (Will not lose time past the 14:30 minute mark)

[Passive] Double Down: Champion takedowns grant a stack, each granting 10 bonus gold on kill. Also take 5% increased damage per stack. Lose all stacks on death.
